query: Super Micro Computer fiscal year end date and quarters
normalized: computer date end fiscal micro quarters super year

output.content:
Super Micro Computer’s fiscal year ends **June 30**; accordingly, FY2026 ran from July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. [[1]] 

Its fiscal quarters are: **Q1 ended September 30; Q2 ended December 31; Q3 ended March 31; and Q4 ended June 30**. The company’s FY2025 filing announcement, for example, identifies Q1 as ending September 30, 2024 and Q2 as ending December 31, 2024. [[2]]
